caption: The image shows a carved and painted wooden figure that depicts three male figures standing side by side, sharing a single body dressed in a long, red robe with black vertical lines running down from the shoulders to the hem. Each figure has a distinct head with dark hair and beard, and their faces are painted with visible eyes, eyebrows, and mouths. Their hands are held in front of them and are joined together by a rope or chain that is rendered in a brownish color and loops around their wrists. The base of the figure is painted in a dark, almost black color, which contrasts with the red of the robe, and it appears to be roughly textured or uneven. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Santo
